name: Siq
author: E. T. Carter
description: Looking straight up from the floor of a slot canyon: a white-hot winding slit of sky cuts diagonally across the frame, flanked by overlapping bulbous sandstone lobes whose flowing strata glow clay-orange near the light and sink into blue-black shade in the near walls. The lobes slide past each other in slow parallax while lit sand sifts down the slit.

params.label: Strata
params.effect: Density of the flowing sandstone bands on every wall lobe.

params.label: Bounce light
params.effect: How much sunlight bounces down the walls, from deep shade to glowing rims.

params.label: Falling sand
params.effect: Amount of lit sand grains sifting down through the slit light.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Speed of the slow parallax drift of the wall lobes along the slit.
